Phase 34 plan submitted: docs/phases/arbiter-cockpit-30-arc.md (brief: docs/tagteam-3.0-proposal.md §4 Phase 34, §8 Q6). Branch phase-34-arbiter-cockpit; PR at the end; release 0.11.0.

Scope: (1) server hardening — ThreadingHTTPServer, loopback bind by default (`--host` opts into remote; called out as a deliberate safety deviation), per-run CSRF token in the served HTML required as X-Tagteam-Token on EVERY POST incl. the pre-existing ones, Origin/Referer check, no `*` CORS on POSTs; (2) read endpoints — /api/now, extended /api/rounds (entries/rulings/interjections), /api/interjections, /api/briefs + /api/brief/<id> + /api/brief/current (same rule as `tagteam brief`), /api/usage (aggregate + per-round churn series + rate-limit signal), /api/scope-diff/<cycle> (new programmatic `cycle.compute_scope_diff` extracted from the CLI, byte-identical CLI output; capped git diff), /api/tail; (3) SSE /api/events — signal-only `change` frames from a per-connection 1 s sampler (state seq, rounds count, interjections/briefs/usage max ids, pause marker, inflight), heartbeat, Last-Event-ID snapshot, per-connection threads with a cap (--max-sse, 503 above), polling fallback retained; (4) write endpoints as thin wrappers over the Phase 32/33 command functions (pause/resume/interject/retire/cancel-turn/brief generate/rule), by=web:<user>, {ok,message}, never a traceback; (5) frontend cockpit.html/js/css (plain JS, EventSource+fetch, panels Now/Inbox/Blockers/Feed/Diff/Usage, confirmations showing the exact CLI), Saloon kept as `?theme=saloon`; (6) schema v6 additive `rate_limits` capturing Claude's rate_limit_event from headless/briefer streams — the honest "subscription window" signal; (7) serve flags; (8) docs; (9) dogfood: this repo's `tagteam serve` during the impl cycle (live Feed, browser pause/resume as the hold, Usage over real rows), a scratch escalation ruled from the browser, two-tab SSE. Out of scope: hub, editing plans/rounds, auth beyond local token/origin, removing the Saloon.

Three open questions with recommendations: loopback default (accept as safety fix), per-run token (recommended), signal-only SSE frames (recommended). Please review against docs/checklists/plan_review.md.

The architecture is directionally sound, and I agree with the recommended per-run token and signal-only SSE design. I also agree that cockpit mode should bind loopback unless `--host` explicitly opts into remote access. Before approval, please resolve these contract and coverage gaps:

1. Restore the 3.0 arc's hard flag-off compatibility guarantee. Proposal §2 says every phase must be opt-in and flag-off behavior identical, but the plan currently makes cockpit the default, changes the default bind from all interfaces to loopback, and requires a token on all legacy POSTs. Define an explicit compatibility matrix. A clean option is: bare `tagteam serve` retains the 0.10 Saloon/bind/API behavior; `--theme cockpit` (or an equivalent config gate) enables the cockpit, loopback-by-default binding, token/origin enforcement, and new action endpoints; `--host` remains the explicit remote override. Add the standing “flag off identical” success criterion and regression tests for the legacy invocation. If the phase truly needs to change bare-command defaults, that is a hard-constraint exception requiring an arbiter decision, not just a plan note.

2. Reconcile “Saloon remains functional unchanged / existing files untouched except a link” with token enforcement on every POST. `tagteam/data/web/app.js` currently POSTs to `/api/config`, `/api/start-phase`, `/api/state`, and `/api/launch` without `X-Tagteam-Token`; therefore `/?theme=saloon` cannot remain functional on a token-enforcing server without code changes. Specify the behavior in each mode and either (a) minimally update Saloon JS to read the injected token and decorate every POST when security is active, listing that file and tests, or (b) keep token enforcement gated off in legacy mode while ensuring the Saloon served from cockpit mode has a working authenticated POST path. Test all four legacy POST routes from both relevant themes/modes, not only raw endpoint requests.

3. Make the new `rate_limits` table repair-safe. It is non-file-backed state, while `db.NON_FILE_BACKED_TABLES` currently enumerates only `usage`, `interjections`, and `briefs`; `repair.rebuild_db_from_files_and_verify()` snapshots/restores exactly that set. Add `rate_limits` to the preservation path, include `tagteam/repair.py` (or the actual preservation implementation) in Files, and add a repair/rebuild test proving the latest signal survives. Keep the proposed older-version-open test as the separate downgrade guarantee.

Please also update the success criteria so these are directly testable. No arbiter interjections were present this round.

Round 2: all three folded in; Open Questions → Decisions.

1. Flag-off guarantee restored with an explicit compatibility matrix (Scope 1): bare `tagteam serve` is 0.10.0-identical — Saloon at `/`, bind all interfaces, no token, same CORS, every new endpoint 404s; `--theme cockpit` (or `serve.theme: cockpit` in tagteam.yaml) enables cockpit mode: cockpit page at `/` (Saloon at `/?theme=saloon`), loopback default with `--host` override, per-run token required on EVERY POST incl. the legacy four, Origin/Referer check, no `*` CORS on POSTs, new read/action endpoints routed. `--host` honored in both modes. `--theme` default = saloon (legacy). The only shared change is ThreadingHTTPServer, covered by legacy regression tests + "open connection doesn't block others". Standing criterion added; legacy invocation regression tests listed (page, four POSTs without token, bind, 404 for new endpoints, no meta token).

2. Saloon + token reconciled: `app.js` gets one minimal mode-agnostic `tagteamFetch()` helper that reads `<meta name="tagteam-token">` (present only in cockpit mode) and adds `X-Tagteam-Token` to /api/config, /api/start-phase, /api/state, /api/launch; legacy mode has no meta ⇒ identical requests. Files/tests updated: all four legacy POST routes exercised the way the pages send them in both modes (legacy no token → 200; cockpit no token → 403; cockpit with embedded token → 200), Saloon served from cockpit mode completes all four.

3. `rate_limits` added to `db.NON_FILE_BACKED_TABLES` (repair iterates that tuple; repair.py listed in Files) with a rebuild test proving the latest signal survives; the older-version-open (0.10.0 opens v6) test remains the separate downgrade guarantee. Criteria updated accordingly.
